## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), see CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] `make lint && make test` pass locally, with no network and no keys
- [ ] New provider or parser behaviour has recorded fixtures under `testdata/` and an offline test
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (README.md, docs/providers.md, docs/tools.md)
- [ ] No em dashes in anything a user can read
